content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with tomato sauce is a ready‑to‑heat meal that stays refrigerated and only needs warming. The combination of al dente pasta and a fragrant tomato sauce seasoned with basil, oregano, and garlic provides a balanced flavor. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sauce is made from ripe tomatoes, which are rich in lycopene – a powerful antioxidant.
The pasta used is typically durum wheat, giving it a firm texture after heating.
The product is often sold in single‑serve packages, making calorie control easy.
Traditional tomato sauce includes olive oil, which enhances absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins.
Microwave heating preserves most nutrients when the recommended time is not exceeded.

items.title: Rich in lycopene
items.content: Lycopene from tomatoes supports heart health and has anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Pasta provides sustained energy through slow‑release glucose.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The sauce and pasta contain B1, B3 and B6, important for metabolic processes.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Ready‑to‑heat versions usually contain little added fat unless extra oil is added.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Tomatoes and whole‑grain pasta contribute fiber that aids normal bowel function.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared meals can be high in salt; people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Wheat pasta contains gluten, making it unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some versions may contain preservatives for shelf life; choose additive‑free options if sensitive.

items.title: Overheating
items.content: Excessive heating can degrade pasta texture and create a bitter taste.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in a microwave or on the stovetop according to package directions (usually 2–3 minutes). For extra flavor, sprinkle grated Parmesan, add fresh basil, or drizzle a little olive oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3‑4 days. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
